title: Art-Lovers near Boston and DC?
excerpt: If you’re in or around Boston, you should check out this show by my friend Bob Jackson. Amazing work! And if you’re around DC, don’t miss Blair Anderson’s show at Ranazul, April 7-30 – reception 4-5 pm on April 20.
body:
If you’re in or around Boston, you should check out this show by my friend Bob Jackson. Amazing work!

And if you’re around DC, don’t miss Blair Anderson’s show at Ranazul, April 7-30 – reception 4-5 pm on April 20.
